title: Lior and the Verdict
author: Astrid Villalobos
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
